1.title: What We Know About the Shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Idaho
1.summary: Gunfire brought panic to a shopping center in Twin Falls in what the authorities described as a chaotic scene. At least three people were killed.

2.title: Spokane Wildfires Destroy Hundreds of Buildings as Thousands Evacuate
2.summary: Firefighters were hopeful that improving weather conditions in Washington state could help their efforts, but worried that fire might spread to a canyon, where it could expand rapidly.

3.title: Ariana Grande pulls out of musical for break from 'endless' scrutiny
3.summary: The US singer, 33, will "step back from visibility" at the end of her world tour, her representative says.

4.title: In Ceuta, Far-Right Leaders Call on Spain to Expel Migrants
4.summary: Far-right politicians and activists are flocking to the Spanish territory on the northern coast of Africa, fueling tensions there days after thousands of migrants entered the exclave.

5.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
5.summary: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

6.title: Canada’s WestJet Cancels Trips Amid Strike By Flight Attendants
6.summary: Labor talks resumed on Sunday between the airline and union representing 4,400 flight attendants, who want improved wages and compensation for unpaid work.
